name: a January 1 streaming cluster still attaches to an October show

source.test: a January 1 streaming cluster still attaches to an October show

why: A streaming catalogue that only knows the year publishes `${year}-01-01`: justwatch, omdb, tmdb, tvdb, unogs and crunchyroll all build that string literally. It is the same show under both rows and the January date is not a claim about a day at all. Believing it costs 14992 of 17946 attaches.
